WHAT EACH TAB DOES
SOP — this page. How to use the file.
Dashboard — live sales performance summary. All numbers update automatically; never type on this tab.
Projected Sales or Lease — the SALES TEAM works here. One row per high-value equipment deal.
Installs — the SERVICE TEAM works here. Tracks equipment through benching and installation.
Lists — the dropdown menus live here. Add new producers or options here and every tab updates automatically.
Install Clock — read-only watch list: who is at risk this week and what to prep next. Nothing is typed here.
SALES TEAM — ENTERING A DEAL (Projected Sales or Lease tab)
1. Start a new row: enter Customer Name, pick the Producer from the dropdown, and enter the Date of Deal.

2. Account Type: ONLY used for Avi or Richard accounts (they do not have access to this file). Pick "Avi Account" or "Richard Account" from the dropdown so we know who owns it. Leave blank for everyone else. This flag stays on this tab — it does not transfer to Installs.
3. Fill in Equipment and Deal Amount ($). A yellow Deal Amount cell means the amount is missing — the Dashboard cannot count the deal’s value until it’s entered.
4. Check Good to Order ✔ when the deal is approved to purchase, and Equipment Ordered ✔ once the order is placed. Enter the Equipment ETA when known.
5. Pick the Payment Terms from the dropdown and enter the Invoice # when issued.
DEAL COMPLETION — THE IMPORTANT COLUMN
✔  (checked) = the deal is FINALIZED. The row turns GREEN, the deal counts as Completed on the Dashboard, and the deal automatically appears in the Installs tab (see next section).
X = the deal FELL THROUGH. The row turns RED and the deal is excluded from every Dashboard figure except the "Fell Through" count. Leave the row in place — do not delete it.
Blank = deal is still active / in the pipeline.
AUTOMATIC TRANSFER TO THE INSTALLS TAB

When Deal Completion is checked ✔, the deal is copied into the "AUTO — NEW COMPLETED DEALS" section near the bottom of the Installs tab (starting at row 161) — but ONLY if that Customer Name is not already in the tracker above. Deals the service team is already tracking are never duplicated.

What transfers: Date (from Date of Deal) · Customer Name · Equipment · Account Rep (the producer’s full name converts to initials: Bill→BM, Lance→LO, Sean→SM, Shannon→SC, Lizbeth→LR, Amanda→AL, Jesus→JG) · Payment Status (from Payment Terms).

The transferred cells show in GREEN TEXT — they are live formulas. Do NOT type over them; they update on their own. If a name or date is wrong, fix it on the Projected Sales or Lease tab and it corrects itself here.

The service team fills in the normal columns by hand for those rows: Equipment Status, Install Date, Assigned Tech, Work Order, Requirements Ready?, and Notes. Install Complete ✔ fills itself when Status = Installed.

Because the check is on Customer Name, the sales tab and the install tab must spell an account the same way. If a completed deal does not appear in the AUTO section and is not already in the tracker, check for a spelling difference.
DASHBOARD — READING THE NUMBERS
KPI cards (top): Active Deals & Active Pipeline $ (deals still open) · Completed Deals & $ · Total Booked $ (active + completed) · Fell Through count.

BY PRODUCER: each producer’s deal count, Sales $ vs Lease $ (Lease = Payment Terms is "Lease"), completed figures, and Open $. "(No producer / not on list)" catches deals with a blank producer or a name not on the Lists tab — the TOTAL row always matches the KPI cards.
BY PAYMENT TERMS and DEAL PROGRESS: how the pipeline splits by terms, and how many deals (and $) have reached Good to Order → Equipment Ordered → Complete.
ADDING OR CHANGING NAMES AND DROPDOWNS (Lists tab)
New producer: type the name at the bottom of the "Producers" column (column Q). It instantly appears in the Producer dropdown and gets its own Dashboard row.
IMPORTANT: also add their initials to the mapping table in columns U–V ("Producer (map)" / "Initials") so completed deals transfer to Installs with the right Account Rep initials.
Payment terms, account types, statuses, reps, and technicians all live on this tab too — add to the bottom of the relevant column.
DO / DON’T
DO: use the dropdowns · fill Date of Deal and Deal Amount on every deal · mark X instead of deleting a dead deal.

DON’T: insert or delete COLUMNS on the Projected or Installs tabs (formulas point at fixed columns) · type in green formula cells · type on the Dashboard · delete, sort, or filter rows in the AUTO section of Installs (the filter buttons at the top of Installs only cover the manual rows 3–148). Do not convert the Installs sheet to an Excel Table — it conflicts with the AUTO section.
SERVICE TEAM — THE INSTALLS TAB

Enter one row per account. Type into the next EMPTY row — do not insert rows (an inserted row comes in without the Install Complete and Install Alert formulas, so it will never flag). Blank rows are already prepared down to row 170.
Equipment Status (dropdown): Ready · Not Ready · Installed. This drives the row color and the Install Clock.
Install Date: enter a REAL DATE (7/27/2026), not text like "week of 7/27". Text dates cannot be scheduled and get flagged "⚠ CHECK DATE".
Assigned Tech (dropdown): Josh, Oliver, Charles, Elias, Ryan, Bill, Lance, 3rd Party. Managed on the Lists tab, "Technicians" column A.
Requirements Ready? (dropdown): Ready / Not Ready — is the CUSTOMER ready for us to install (site, power, plumbing, sign-off)?
Install Complete ✔ and ⚠ Install Alert fill in on their own — do not type in them.
ROW COLORS — ONE RULE FOR EVERY ROW
RED = needs attention now (anything in the ⚠ Install Alert column). Beats every other color.
GREEN = Equipment Status is Installed — done.
AMBER = Equipment Status is Not Ready (and not urgent yet).
BLUE = Equipment Status is Ready — waiting on the install date.
Plain / faint stripe = no status picked yet.

Every row in the tracker, including the AUTO section, follows this exact order. If a row is not coloring, its Equipment Status cell is empty or was typed by hand instead of picked from the dropdown (watch for stray spaces).
THE INSTALL CLOCK (its own tab)

The Installs tab shows the counters across the top; the Install Clock tab shows the full detail. It reads the current calendar week (Monday–Sunday) plus the following week, and watches every account with an install date in that window.
⚠ EQUIP NOT READY — install is this week or next and Equipment Status is Not Ready. This is the main one to work.
⚠ PAST DUE - NOT READY — the install date has already passed and the equipment still is not ready.
⚠ CUSTOMER NOT READY — equipment is fine but Requirements Ready? is Not Ready and the install is this week or next.
⚠ CHECK DATE — Not Ready account whose Install Date is text, so it cannot be scheduled. Replace it with a real date.
Everything refreshes when the file is opened or recalculated (F9). The AT RISK list shows the first 10 and the PREP QUEUE the next 20; the note under each says how many more there are.
Installed accounts are never flagged.
INSTALL DATES — CALENDAR DATES ONLY
Date Received and Install Date now only accept a real calendar date. Typing "week of 8/3" is rejected with a message explaining why.
Fastest ways to enter one: type 8/3/26 · press Ctrl + ; for today · or copy a date cell and paste.
If you only know the week, enter the MONDAY of that week and put the detail in Notes. A week-only note cannot be scheduled or counted.
Existing "week of ..." entries were converted to the date named, and the original wording was added to that row’s Notes.
PREP QUEUE — WHAT TO GET READY NEXT
On the Install Clock tab, under the at-risk list. It lists every account NOT yet marked Installed, soonest install date first. Work it top to bottom.
Days out: negative = the install date has already passed · 0 = today · "needs date" = no install date set yet (these sort to the bottom and need scheduling).
Row colors in the queue: RED = late or installing today · AMBER = installing this week, or no date yet · GREEN = further out.
An account leaves the queue the moment its Equipment Status is set to Installed.

Deals that arrive in the AUTO section come in with a blank Equipment Status, so they show as "needs date" until the service team sets a status and an install date. That is the hand-off point from sales to service.
WHY THE CLOCK IS ON ITS OWN TAB

Only 4 rows are frozen at the top of the Installs tab (title, counters, column headers) so the account list scrolls normally. The detailed at-risk and prep lists live on the Install Clock tab, one click away via the link in cell C1.
NO DUPLICATES BETWEEN SALES AND SERVICE
The AUTO section only shows completed deals whose Customer Name is NOT already somewhere in the tracker above it.
The bottom of the Install Clock tab shows the reconciliation: how many deals are complete, how many are new to service, and how many were already being tracked.
Two account names were made consistent so the check matches: "Local Foods - ATX 2" → "Local Foods - ATX #2", and "Taha" → "Taha Market Mediterranean Foods".
If you ever want a completed deal to stop showing in the AUTO section, add it to the tracker above under the same name (or set its Equipment Status to Installed).
